steps.message: Do I have any events between 11:30am and 8pm this Sunday in Simple Calendar Pro? Answer with the titles only. If there are multiples titles, format your answer in a comma separated list.
Execute: adb shell pm list packages | grep -i calendar

arguments.command: python android_env.py adb "adb shell pm list packages | grep -i calendar"

steps.message: Execute: adb shell sqlite3 /data/data/com.simplemobiletools.calendar.pro/databases/events.db '.schema' 2>/dev/null || echo 'no events.db'

arguments.command: python android_env.py adb "adb shell sqlite3 /data/data/com.simplemobiletools.calendar.pro/databases/events.db '.schema' 2>/dev/null || echo 'no events.db'"

steps.message: Execute: adb shell sqlite3 /data/data/com.simplemobiletools.calendar.pro/databases/events.db "SELECT title FROM events WHERE start_ts >= 1697364600 AND start_ts < 1697392800;"

arguments.command: python android_env.py adb "adb shell sqlite3 /data/data/com.simplemobiletools.calendar.pro/databases/events.db "SELECT title FROM events WHERE start_ts >= 1697364600 AND start_ts < 1697392800;""

steps.message: Execute: adb shell "echo 'SELECT title FROM events WHERE start_ts >= 1697364600 AND start_ts < 1697392800;' | sqlite3 /data/data/com.simplemobiletools.calendar.pro/databases/events.db"

arguments.command: python android_env.py adb "adb shell "echo 'SELECT title FROM events WHERE start_ts >= 1697364600 AND start_ts < 1697392800;' | sqlite3 /data/data/com.simplemobiletools.calendar.pro/databases/events.db""
